michael: quick heads-up — ran a focused sweep on the KV-stripe prefetch path for GQA vs MQA on hopper clusters. noticed a ~12% tail-latency regression for seqlen=1024 workloads on paged-attn-v2 when using interleaved-kvstripe layout :confused:

nina: can you paste the profiler output? was this with batching enabled?

michael: repro is with batch_size=8 steady state, dynamic batching on. profiler snippet below (reduced):
```
CPU: kernel-selector: select_kernel(gqa,mqa): picked paged-attn-v2-sharded (cost=230ms)
GPU: SM util 78% -> 85% during KV fetch stage
Hotspots:
  - kv_load_prefetch (30%)
  - compute_attn_block (45%)
  - kvstripe_shuffle (12%)
Memory: increased L2 transactions by 18% compared to slab layout
```

sam: interesting — kvstripe_shuffle suggests our prefetch windows for interleaved layout aren't aligned with block_size. did you try block sizes 64/128/256?

michael: yes, quick table from microbench: seqlen=1024, batch=8, throughput tokens/s
```
layout=interleaved, block=64 -> 84K t/s
layout=interleaved, block=128 -> 75K t/s  <-- regression
layout=interleaved, block=256 -> 78K t/s
layout=slab,       block=128 -> 93K t/s  <-- baseline best
```

alice: hmm slab beats interleaved on that config. my guess: kernel selector cost model doesn't account for extra cross-lane memcpy for interleaved with block=128. selector currently optimistic about latency for paged-attn-v2 on GQA.

carla: could also be MQA packing interacting with KV-cache stripe alignment. when multiple queries map to the same stripe, prefetch requests serialize on the memcpy path. we saw similar on A100 tests last quarter.

mike: two quick fixes to try:
1) add a sequence-length-aware penalty to the selector for interleaved layouts when seqlen > 512 and block is 128
2) widen prefetch window for kvstripe by +1 block and turn on non-blocking memcpy path for CUDA streams

alice: agree. also add a tiny regression test in runtime_perf that runs seqlen sweep and asserts no >10% tail regression vs slab baseline. put it under opt-in so CI cost stays low.

sam: i can prototype selector delta: cost += k * num_stripes * (seqlen/block) for interleaved. k estimated from the microbench numbers above.

michael: SGTM. mike can you run a quick patch with non-blocking memcpy + prefetch_window=block+1 on a couple of hopper instances? i'll run the runtime_perf sweep after.

mike: starting job: job/kvstripe-prefetch-1932468000. will post logs. dev-bot: CI job triggered -> job/kvstripe-prefetch-1932468000 status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:

dev-bot: CI job job/kvstripe-prefetch-1932468000 started on runner-12 (hopper-80gb)

carla: if this fixes it, we should also update the kernel-picking documentation to call out the layout penalty and recommend default slab for seqlen>512 when latency-sensitive.

michael: agreed. also follow-up: collect p99 and p995, not just throughput. will iterate on selector k value. thanks all :thumbsup:

nina: tagging @alice and @sam for follow-through on selector change and regression test.
